source.map: City of Portland plan districts East Corridor (33.521), Glendoveer (33.530), Hollywood (33.536), Kenton (33.538), Lombard (33.545), Macadam (33.550), North Interstate (33.561), Northwest Hills (33.563), West Portland Multicultural (33.595), Central City (33.510), Columbia South Shore (33.515), Gateway (33.526), Hayden Island (33.532), Marquam Hill (33.555), Northwest (33.562), Powell Boulevard (33.567), Sandy Boulevard (33.575) and South Auditorium (33.580), their subdistricts and mapped streets and lines as Portland Maps publishes them
source.says: Each traced lot is one a plan district rule reaches that the screen does not measure: where parking and driveways may go against a named street or light rail line, a required building line, a minimum floor area ratio printed only on a map (Kenton Map 538-3) or above what the pod can supply, a mapped prohibition of residential use, a rear setback set as a share of site depth, a setback set by wall-plane area, the Linnton Hillside lot-of-record rule, or the Glendoveer flag-lot standards (15 ft from every lot line, 25 ft height, 33.530.050), which the screen cannot apply because no lot is read as a flag lot; batch B adds where parking and driveways may go against a Gateway street or light rail line or a Northwest main street or streetcar line, a minimum floor area ratio above what the pod can supply (Northwest CM2, and CM3 near a main street or streetcar, 1.5:1; Central City at least 1:1 keyed to Map 510-2), the Northwest limit of residential use to 20 percent of a building (Map 562-2), a height printed only on a map below the pod (Northwest 0 ft, Columbia South Shore 20 and 30 ft view corridors, Central City 25 ft, Marquam Hill heights above sea level), building walls set parallel to Sandy Boulevard, the Powell Boulevard 8 ft sound wall, the South Auditorium 15 ft landscaped street edge and tree rule, the Hayden Island commercial-zone height step, floor area and coverage rules, and the Columbia South Shore Airport Way setback and archaeology rule; and (2026-11-12) every Kenton CM2, CM3 or CE zoned ground (33.538.230): exterior walls on the Map 538-4 frontages must be at least 25 feet high, which the 20 ft pod cannot meet, and Map 538-4 is not yet traced, so the whole Kenton commercial ground is held for a check by hand (or/multnomah/portland/33.538.txt#L110-L114; multi-dwelling zoned sites are exempt)

inputs.taxlots_c: pd2c re-adds, inside the GA and EC minimum-FAR polygons only: GA lots of run 113 by the batch B rule; EC lots from the quadfit s1 taxlots of 2026-07 (every run-113 EC TLID is among them), their street faces recomputed with quadfit s4_edges.classify_lot (50 ft, 1.5 ft) against every s1 street segment, alleys counted as streets
inputs.kenton_walls: Portland Maps Public/Zoning MapServer layer 0 (Zoning Designations), where PLDIST='KN', ZONE in CM2/CM3/CE (9 polygons; none CE), fetched 2026-11-12; unioned whole, not cut to lots -- every lot on that ground is held

source.method: Lots at least one tenth inside the district, taken whole: EC through lots and lots with two or more street faces within 75 ft of E Burnside; NI lots outside the R zones within 30 ft of a required building line, and lots with two or more street faces within 75 ft of N Interstate; HW every Subdistrict A lot, and lots with two or more street faces within 75 ft of an Enhanced Pedestrian Street; WP every Subdistrict A and B lot, CM2 and CM3 lots within 75 ft of a commercial corridor, and RM1-RM3 lots in Subdistrict C that are not corner lots and are over 100 ft deep or of unknown depth; MA every lot; LB Subdistrict B lots with two or more street faces; GL R7 lots of geometry tier C (34 on run 113, none green), the lots a flag lot can be among. Street faces and corners read from front_bearings_deg. Unioned with the KN 1:1 minimum-FAR polygons and the NH Linnton Hillside subarea outline, untraced (no lot inside the KN or NH areas was green on run 113). Coordinates to 0.01 ft. Batch B, the same way (lots at least one tenth inside, taken whole): GA lots with two or more street faces and lots within 150 ft of a MAX line; NP every CM2 lot, CM3 lots within 240 ft of a Map 562-7 main street or streetcar centreline or at least one tenth inside the residential-limited area, and lots within 60 ft of one with two or more street faces or over 10,000 sf; SD lots within 75 ft of the NE Sandy Blvd centreline; HI lots in a C zone; PB, SA, SS, CC, CCSA and MH every lot. Unioned with the NP Map 562-4 0 ft height polygon, untraced. Airport (33.565) adds nothing: its one site standard binds IG2 only. pd2c (2026-11-04): the GA Map 526-3 .25 and EC Map 521-3 .5:1 and 1:1 minimum-FAR polygons, now read as drawn figures (gateway-min-far.geojson, east-corridor-min-far-half.geojson, east-corridor-min-far-one.geojson), were cut out of the hold, and the lots inside them that the traced rules hold were put back whole: GA by the batch B rule on run 113 (two or more street faces, or within 150 ft of a MAX line; 295 lots); EC wider than batch A, because the faces were recomputed on the July taxlots and reproduce the run-113 tracing only in part: every EC lot touching the polygons with two or more street faces of any angle, or within 100 ft of the E Burnside centreline (199 of 548). Checked on the EC lots outside the polygons, the wider rule holds all 102 lots the run-113 tracing holds (the batch A rule recomputed missed 12). Fix after the held pd2c bound (2026-11-05): the batch B Gateway rule read street faces from front_bearings_deg, which counts a through lot's two parallel street faces as one bearing, so through lots slipped out; a through lot now counts as two street faces, and the 15 Gateway lots touching the .25 polygons that the screen reads as through lots (observed through_lot) and the hold had dropped were put back whole.
